space.$description: Spacing in points (1 CSS px = 1 pt on the display canvases). Our choice: a 4 pt base unit, the rhythm iOS layouts follow.

compact.$description: UIKit default layout margin in compact width (iPhone)

regular.$description: UIKit default layout margin in regular width

hitTarget.$description: Apple HIG minimum hit target on iOS (44 x 44 pt)

glassButton.$description: Our choice: circular Liquid Glass bar button, matching the hit target

rail.$description: Width of Duo's Vertical Bar (the rail), the content's trailing limit: 12 leading + 48 column + 24 trailing. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit (Sketch, public library, Sept 2026), read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

railInset.$description: Rail column centre from the trailing edge of the display (24 + 48 / 2), on both displays; on the outer display this is the camera's column. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit (Sketch, public library, Sept 2026), read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

railEdge.$description: Rail padding at the top, bottom, and trailing edge. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit (Sketch, public library, Sept 2026), read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

railLead.$description: Rail padding on its leading side. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit (Sketch, public library, Sept 2026), read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

railButton.$description: Rail column width; a single toolbar button ('Toolbars / Buttons / 48pt / Symbol 1') is a 48 x 48 glass circle. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit (Sketch, public library, Sept 2026), read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

railSymbol.$description: A button inside a toolbar group: 36 x 36, its symbol centred. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit (Sketch, public library, Sept 2026), read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

railGroupPad.$description: Padding at each end of a vertical toolbar group ('Vertical Group - Symbol 2/3': 48 x 110 / 164). [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit (Sketch, public library, Sept 2026), read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

railGroupGap.$description: Space between buttons in a toolbar group (a 54 pt pitch). [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit (Sketch, public library, Sept 2026), read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

railGap.$description: Space between the status and the toolbar, and between toolbar groups. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit (Sketch, public library, Sept 2026), read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

railCameraGap.$description: Outer display: space between the camera punchout (43 x 42) and the status. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit (Sketch, public library, Sept 2026), read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

cameraPunch.$description: Outer display: width of the camera punchout at the top of the rail (42 tall). [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit, read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

cameraPunchHeight.$description: Outer display: height of the camera punchout. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit, read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

cameraLens.$description: Outer Display Lens: the camera drawn in the punchout, #080808. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit, read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

cameraLensTop.$description: The lens's offset from the punchout's top (centre 47.8 pt from the display's top). [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit, read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

symbol.$description: Font size that draws a 17 pt SF Symbol with our icons (a 24-unit box is 24 pt at 17 pt; icons.ts). Toolbar symbols are 17 pt in the kit. Derived

symbolTab.$description: Font size for an 18 pt symbol (tab bar), 24 x 18 / 17. Derived from the kit's 18 pt tab symbols

tabItem.$description: Height of a tab in Duo's vertical tab bar (48 wide). [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit (Sketch, public library, Sept 2026), read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

tabPad.$description: Padding at each end of the vertical tab bar; tabs are 2 pt apart. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit (Sketch, public library, Sept 2026), read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

tabPill.$description: Height of the selected tab's pill (44 wide, centred on its tab). [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit (Sketch, public library, Sept 2026), read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

tabPillWidth.$description: Width of the selected tab's pill (64 tall), 2 pt in from the tab bar's sides. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit, read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

tabSearchGap.$description: Space between the tab bar and its separate search button (48 x 48). [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit (Sketch, public library, Sept 2026), read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

topBar.$description: Inner display in portrait: height of the top toolbar row; title at (20, 37), trailing actions (glass groups, then the horizontal status) 24 pt from the top and trailing edges, 12 pt apart. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit (Sketch, public library, Sept 2026), read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

topBarTitleX.$description: Portrait top bar: the title's leading inset. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit, read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

topBarTitleY.$description: Portrait top bar: the title's top. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit, read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

sheetInset.$description: Outer display: a sheet's inset from the display edges; corners 40 (top), 48 (trailing bottom), 8 (hinge-side bottom), concentric with the display. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit (Sketch, public library, Sept 2026), read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

sheetRadius.$description: Outer sheet: top corner radius. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit, read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

sheetRadiusTrailing.$description: Outer sheet: trailing bottom corner, concentric with the display's large corner. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit, read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

sheetRadiusHinge.$description: Outer sheet: hinge-side bottom corner, concentric with the display's small corner. [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit, read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

sheetGrabber.$description: Outer sheet: grabber width (4 tall, 10 from the top). [KIT] Apple iOS 27 UI Kit, read in its Inspector; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

sidebar.$description: Leading pane of a split view on the inner display, open flat: ≈ 34% of 951 pt. Folded (Book) it snaps to half. Measured from Apple's HIG figures (Mail, Notes) and owner-supplied references; docs/duo-ui.md section 2

foldBand.$description: Folding region excluded from interactive content while partially folded: ≈ 27 pt in Apple's inner-display diagram (not a published value).

radius.$description: Corner radii in points. Nested shapes should be concentric: child radius = parent radius - padding (Apple WWDC25-356).

concentricMin.$description: Our choice: the minimum radius a concentric corner may resolve to (Apple's concentric(minimum:) idea), so hinge-side corners never go square
